OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_EVENT_TERRARIA_REUN:
You encounter a familiar figure.

“Hey! At last we meet again, my friend!”

The [gold]Guide[/gold] walks over happily.

“I never expected you to go to another world! I still have a few of the accessories you left behind. You can only take one, but it should help you on your way.”

The Guide smiles as you put away your accessory.

“I hope you can return home to Terraria someday. Everyone and I miss you very much.”
You bid your old friend farewell and continue your journey.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_EVENT_SWORD_IN_THE_:
You arrive at a tranquil lake. The sword at your waist suddenly emits a faint glow.

Ripples spread across the lake, and a mysterious woman slowly emerges.

“The sword in your hand seems to conceal its true power. Will you awaken it?”

Water encircles the blade, gradually forming a new holy sword.

“May this sword clear the obstacles before you.”

You obtain [gold]Excalibur[/gold].

Dazzling golden light bursts from the blade, and the lake reflects the holy sword’s true form.

“It seems you already possess the strength to wield it.”

You obtain [gold]True Excalibur[/gold].

You put away your sword and continue your journey.

The lake behind you grows still once more.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_EVENT_DRAGON_BALL_T:
You arrive at an unfamiliar training ground. Three figures radiating powerful energy notice you.

One of them speaks:

“We don’t know why you came here, but you seem to need help. We can teach you our signature techniques.”

After some instruction, you master a new technique.

Before you leave, one of the teachers hands you a strange device.

“This is a Scouter. It can reveal an enemy’s power level. It isn’t completely accurate, though, so don’t rely on it too much.”

You obtain your chosen technique card.

You obtain a Scouter.

“Traveler, did you drop this [gold]golden {Item}[/gold], or your worn-out [gold]{Item}[/gold]?”

A goddess emerges from the water, holding a [gold]golden card[/gold] and a silver card.

“Traveler, did you drop this [gold]golden card[/gold], or this silver card?”

The goddess nods with satisfaction.

“Honest traveler, take these as your reward!”

The goddess frowns and returns your original item.

“Guilt is hardly a good habit.”

You say nothing and turn away.

OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_EVENT_SCP294.title: SCP-294: The Coffee Machine
A coffee machine stands quietly before you. A label beside the coin slot reads: Drinks, [gold]50 Gold[/gold].
The coins drop into the machine, and the panel lights up. First, choose a taste.
Pay [gold]50 Gold[/gold] to brew a drink.
The machine gives a short hum. Next, choose how the drink should feel.
A paper cup slides beneath the spout. Finally, choose the drink's concentration.
The machine rumbles, and an anomalous drink slides from the dispenser. You obtain [gold]{Potion}[/gold].
